title: helpdesk_notes
description: Structured notes captured from an internal IT helpdesk call. This flow is caller-led (config/interview_flows/helpdesk.yaml has no slots), so every field is inferred from the transcript by the notes extractor. Booleans are modeled as yes/no/unknown enums so schema repair (agent/notes.py) coerces them safely.

issue_category.description: Best-fit category for the reported issue.

issue_summary.description: One-sentence summary of the problem in the employee's own terms.

affected_system.description: The system, app, or device involved (e.g. VPN client, Outlook, laptop, finance share). Empty if unclear.

urgency.description: How blocking the issue is for the employee's work.

steps_attempted.description: Troubleshooting steps tried during the call, in order.

resolution_status.description: Outcome of the call: fixed, still open, handed to a human, or not determined.

escalation_required.description: Whether the issue needs a human team (unresolved, out of KB, unsafe, or beyond the assistant's authority).

escalation_reason.description: Short reason for escalation if required, otherwise empty.

security_sensitive.description: Whether the call touched a security-sensitive matter (suspicious MFA prompt, credential exposure, lost device, refused unsafe request).

follow_up_notes.description: Anything a human agent should know to follow up, otherwise empty.
